messages.subject: Re: plot dotted line shaped with condition using geom_smooth
parts:
It's hard to tell what's happening without a sample data set (hint!),
but perhaps using linetype=factor(sex) in the ggplot call, and then
linetype=sex in the geom_smooth call, is causing problems?

Ben


On Fri, Oct 19, 2012 at 12:26 PM, Lydia Jia <jial...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I am plotting regression line using geom_smooth and I would like to make the
> line of black, dotted with circle, square and ... under different groups.
>
> p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y,
> shape = assign, linetype = factor(sex)))
>
> p0b <- p +
> scale_linetype_manual(breaks=c("0","1"), values=c(1,2), labels = c("male",
> "female")) +
> geom_smooth(aes(shape = assign, linetype = sex), method = "lm", se =
> FALSE, size = 1.2) +
> # geom_point(aes(shape = assign),size = 4) +
> scale_shape_manual(values=c(17, 0, 19))
>
> the smooth line should be dotted under different assigns. anyone knows how
> to do it?
